source_cause: ScreenManager pops the outgoing screen before EndScreen calls PlayCommand(End); ActorFrame propagates End to foreground owners. Production gameplay called scene.end only when an explicit Lua transition timer completed. Natural completion requested the shell fade without an owned Lua End. Dispatching End at that Navigate request is too early: NotesEnded waits for the next actor update, LeaveGameplay dispatches Off, and the out transition must finish before ScreenManager pops the screen. Route natural Lua completion through that real owned transition clock to reach the retained final five-event jmouth block.
change: Share idempotent shutdown for completed owned out transitions and immediate pops. Natural completion waits for the existing owned Off dispatch, starts the out transition after that update, and preserves its original completion clock across repeated Core requests. Navigate fade-start requests remain live. Bind each retained player actor to its owned life meter instead of requiring a current top screen for SetLife. Apply End player writes and output, detach callbacks, and prevent further update or draw after shutdown.
regression_control: Production prepare_song_lua, gameplay init and real clocked gameplay update reach natural Evaluation navigation. A retained root asleep for9999seconds owns a Sprite whose authored queue first dispatches End; Off runs while GetTopScreen remains live, then completed out transition dispatches End again with GetTopScreen nil, applies retained player life writes, does not advance the second End queue or draw the popped scene, and a later update emits no output.
